title.narrative: Indigenous Peoples Champions for the Philippines

description.narrative: The Actions overall goal is to enhance indigenous peoples rights in the Philippines by contributing to a situation where indigenous communities have empowered advocates who can demand rights, and where institutions responsible for upholding these rights have the knowledge and skills to respond to such requests to effectively fulfil their mandates.

title.narrative: Indigenous communities in the Philippines have empowered advocates who can demand rights,and institutions responsible for upholding these rights have the knowledge and skills to respond to such requests to effectively fulfil their mandates.

description.narrative: Indigenous communities in the Philippines have empowered advocates who can demand rights,and institutions responsible for upholding these rights have the knowledge and skills to respond to such requests to effectively fulfil their mandates.Indigenous communities in the Philippines have empowered advocates who can demand rights,and institutions responsible for upholding these rights have the knowledge and skills to respond to such requests to effectively fulfil their mandates.

title.narrative: A qualitative assessment will be made at the end of the project based on the informationgathered through the monitoring and evaluation of the progress markers.

description.narrative: A qualitative assessment will be made at the end of the project based on the informationgathered through the monitoring and evaluation of the progress markers.

comment.narrative: There is currently lack of clarity and understanding of legal and institutional frameworks for indigenous rights on the supply and demand side. Indigenous communities have limited advocacy skills and the institutional actors areoften confused by overlapping mandates and may not be aware of international and domestic laws and standards relevant to their work.

Indigenous communities have empowered advocates who can demand rights and institutions responsible for upholding these rights have the knowledge and skills to respond to such requests to effectively fulfil their mandates.
